_comment: Editorial content for FEM. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. FEM is both a modaraba and a brokerage house; the two service lines are described in the text rather than padded into a product list.
description: First Equity Modaraba is a perpetual, multi-purpose closed-end modaraba — a listed Islamic financing vehicle — managed by Premier Financial Services (Private) Limited, whose board comes from the Crescent Group. Floated at the end of 1991, it undertakes murabaha, musharika, trading, manufacturing, equity investment and fee-based activities, and was the first modaraba in Pakistan to hold membership of all three stock exchanges and operate a brokerage business, which it has run since 2002. It has a wholly owned subsidiary, Equity Textiles Limited.
